answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the willow is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Every checkpoint root is anchored to a public chain and the full history replays for anyone. That makes each attestation permanently attributable: a whisper that vouched for junk is a timestamped record the audit lanes can act on later. The wander ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal fgdf7.
